fullSource:
use default

let capitals = MAP()

capitals.add("France", "Paris")
capitals.add("Japan", "Tokyo")
capitals.add("Peru", "Lima")

write_line("keys:   {capitals.keys |> sort() |> join(", ")}")
write_line("values: {capitals.values |> sort() |> join(", ")}")

for (country, capital) in capitals do
    write_line("the capital of {country} is {capital}")
od
output:
keys:   France, Japan, Peru
values: Lima, Paris, Tokyo
the capital of France is Paris
the capital of Japan is Tokyo
the capital of Peru is Lima
